High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Gwalior

sentences.text: 1. This is the first bail application under Section 483 of BNSS, 2023 on behalf of the applicant, who is in custody since 6.3.2025 in connection with crime No.62/2024 registered at Police Station Crime Branch, District Gwalior for offence under Sections 420 of IPC r/w Sections 66C, 66D of IT Act subsequently added Sections 467, 468, 471 and 120-B of IPC.
2. At the outset, learned counsel for the applicant confined his prayer only to consideration of his application for interim bail and prayed for withdrawal of the main bail application.
3. Prayer accepted.
4. Main bail application is dismissed as withdrawn.

5. Heard on I.A.No.9574 of 2025, an application for interim bail on behalf of NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-GWL:10282 2 MCRC-12936-2025 the applicant - Vinay Tomar on the ground of severe illness.
6.
Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that the applicant has filed this application for interim bail on the ground of illness of self illness.
It is submitted that the applicant is suffering from some testicles problem and his treatment is being going on.
It is further submitted that the applicant's health is getting deteriorated and hence requires proper treatment.
Therefore, interim bail may be granted to the applicant for a period of two months.

7. Learned counsel for the State vehemently opposed the application and prayed for rejection of Vinay Tomar vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 9 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/130535411/
1 interim bail application.
8.

entities.text: Vinay Tomar vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the parties and considered the arguments advanced by them and perused the available record.

9. In view of the aforesaid, I.A. No.9574/2025 for grant of interim bail is allowed and it is hereby directed that the applicant shall be released on bail for a temporary period till 18.05.2025 on his furnishing personal bond of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the concerned trial Court.
The applicant shall surrender before the trial Court on or before 19.05.2025.
The intimation regarding surrender of the applicant be furnished to this Court.
In case of failure to comply the order, this bail order shall automatically stand cancelled.
It is made clear that no further interim bail shall be granted to the applicant on this ground.
12. I.A.No.9574/2025 stands disposed of in above terms.
As prayed by learned counsel for the applicant above, the present bail application is dismissed as withdrawn.
Let a copy of this order be sent to the trial Court concerned for compliance.
